From stunning furniture & home décor to statement jewellery, clothing, textiles, unique handicrafts and gifting options, there’s so much to explore under one roof! 😍✨ 

You can also shop a variety of other products while discovering exciting finds from across India, Thailand and Afghanistan. 💯

📍 Location: MMRDA Grounds, BKC, Mumbai
⏰ Timings: Please check the official event schedule before visiting.
